spanish: también yo haré esto a ustedes: y visitaré sobre ustedes terror, la tisis y la fiebre, acabando ojos y haciendo languidecer alma; y sembrarán en vacío su semilla, y la comerán sus enemigos.

findings.issue: Hiphil 1cs of פקד licenses appointing or setting upon; visitaré is a simple visit.
Piel participle feminine plural: the afflictions end the eyes; the gerund assigns that act to the speaker.
Hiphil participle feminine plural: the afflictions cause the soul to languish; haciendo assigns the causing to the speaker.
ל plus emptiness is to or for emptiness; en is spatial in.
Object suffix is 3ms on the seed; la is feminine smoothing to semilla.

notes: 2mp ustedes and dual ojos stay licensed; את markers carry no extra Spanish concept.
